notes: New: Depth focus. Words baked into a wallpaper fight the interface — so when AI information comes to the front, the wallpaper now recedes. Open the Lens conversation or Reach and the background softens with a blur, dims, and pushes back with a slight scale, while the information surface gains a real cast shadow and the Lens itself stays optically sharp against the softened world. Close the surface and the wallpaper settles back, crisp and full-bleed. It animates only during the open and close — at rest nothing moves and nothing costs GPU. Turn it off under Appearance, Depth focus, if you prefer the wallpaper untouched.
